protected_features.why: Every subsequent FE, Training, and Diagnosis call must respect these.

durable_rules.rule: Every learned model must report MAE vs baseline_floor PER HORIZON before any stop decision.
durable_rules.why: A model below the naive floor is worse than doing nothing.
durable_rules.cost_if_broken: A deployed model that loses to a trivial rule goes undetected.

durable_rules.rule: naive_predictor_features must be materialised in every FE call: exact column names, exact formulas, horizon-scoped.
durable_rules.why: These are the run's guaranteed floor-level signal.
durable_rules.cost_if_broken: Feature set missing the floor-level anchor.

durable_rules.rule: A node proposing to DROP any column in protected_features MUST raise a BLOCKING clarification and NOT drop on its own.
durable_rules.why: Naive predictor columns score near-zero in masked importance and flag in multicollinearity — known artefacts.

methodological_cautions.caution: h=90 floor (pooled 3 folds, n=257) is modest.
methodological_cautions.why: Dataset ends 2020-12-31; origins for h=90 are early in the gap.
methodological_cautions.cost_if_ignored: h=90 champion selection based on fold-3 alone = 5 rows (random).

methodological_cautions.caution: Monday (DOW=0) has only 5 training observations post-regime (June 2020). Seasonal lookbacks for Mondays include pre-regime zero rows, biasing seasonal statistics downward.
methodological_cautions.why: Pre-regime Mondays are closed (zero demand); the seasonal window w=52 will include ~47 zero-demand pre-regime Mondays for any post-regime Monday origin.
methodological_cautions.cost_if_ignored: seasonal_mean_w52 is severely biased for Monday targets; FE must include regime_x_monday feature.

do_not_repeat.tried: Restricting Part A to only 6 fixed rules
do_not_repeat.evidence: Part B showed shorter windows (smedian_w13) have substantially lower train MAE; expanding Part A to the same grid finds better floor rules.
do_not_repeat.why_not_again: 6 rules is an arbitrary restriction that misses better trivial predictors.

do_not_repeat.tried: Scoring h=90 baseline on fold 3 alone
do_not_repeat.evidence: Fold 3 has only 5 scoreable h=90 val rows; SE of MAE is ~45% of mean.
do_not_repeat.why_not_again: 5 rows insufficient for reliable MAE estimation.
